finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker can inject a malicious URL that includes shell metacharacters or control operators.
finding.assumptions: The 'url' variable is attacker-controlled and can be manipulated to include shell metacharacters or control operators.

parsed.refutation_attempt: The 'url' variable is used only as a string in the HTTP request and does not appear to be used in any way that would allow for OS command injection. The 'url' variable is passed to the 'send_request' function, which constructs an HTTP GET request using 'snprintf'. There are no system calls or shell commands being executed that could be influenced by the 'url' variable. Additionally, the 'url' variable is not used in any way that would allow for command injection.
